say:1:1510652001:1.text: What is this? Looks like a black, writhing tree...
say:1:1510652001:1.source_cn: 这是？一棵黑色的、扭动的树……
say:1:1510652001:1.male: What is this? Looks like a black, writhing tree...
say:1:1510652001:1.female: What is this? Looks like a black, writhing tree...

say:3:1510652003:1.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you handle this? If it's too much for you, just look away.
say:3:1510652003:1.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you handle this? If it's too much for you, just look away.
say:3:1510652003:1.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, can you handle this? If it's too much for you, just look away.

say:6:1510652005:1.text: Okay, turn away. Just listen to my voice.
say:6:1510652005:1.source_cn: 好，转过头去吧。只要听我说就好。
say:6:1510652005:1.male: Okay, turn away. Just listen to my voice.
say:6:1510652005:1.female: Okay, turn away. Just listen to my voice.

say:7:1510652008:0.text: Countless souls are trapped here, unable to find peace.
say:7:1510652008:0.source_cn: 许多被束缚的灵魂困在此处，不得安宁。
say:7:1510652008:0.male: Countless souls are trapped here, unable to find peace.
say:7:1510652008:0.female: Countless souls are trapped here, unable to find peace.

say:8:1510652009:0.text: That's why we keep hearing those screams... They can't leave, they are suffering. All they can do is shriek into the endless darkness.
say:8:1510652009:0.source_cn: 所以我们不断听到哀嚎声，他们无法离开，无法解脱，只能在...
say:8:1510652009:0.male: That's why we keep hearing those screams... They can't leave, they are suffering. All they can do is shriek into the endless darkness.
say:8:1510652009:0.female: So that's why we keep hearing those screams... They can't leave, they are suffering. All they can do is shriek into this endless darkness.

say:9:1510652010:0.text: I know this place is unsettling... Just hang in there a little longer. I promise you'll be fine once we leave here.
say:9:1510652010:0.source_cn: 我知道这样的场景让你很不舒服……再坚持一下吧。等离开这...
say:9:1510652010:0.male: I know this place is unsettling... Just hang in there a little longer. I promise you'll be fine once we leave here.
say:9:1510652010:0.female: I know this place is unsettling... Just hang in there a little longer. I promise you'll be fine once we leave here.

say:13:1510652013:1.text: You mean this Wailing Oak... Sedecim, I'm sorry. I'm so sorry your master has been turned into... this.
say:13:1510652013:1.source_cn: 这棵人面树……十六，我很抱歉，你的主人变成了这副模样。

choice_prompt:14:1510652013.text: You mean this Wailing Oak... Sedecim, I'm sorry. I'm so sorry your master has been turned into... this.
choice_prompt:14:1510652013.source_cn: 这棵人面树……十六，我很抱歉，你的主人变成了这副模样。

say:16:1510652015:1.text: I know. And we won't go back on our word.
say:16:1510652015:1.source_cn: 我知道，所以我们不会食言。

say:17:1510652016:0.text: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please stay with me just a bit longer. We have to find that light source and force the God of Harvest to show himself.
say:17:1510652016:0.male: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please stay with me just a bit longer. We have to find that light source and force the God of Harvest to show himself.
say:17:1510652016:0.female: <style="stress"><player_name></style>, please stay with me just a bit longer. We have to find that light source and force the God of Harvest to show himself.

say:18:1510652017:1.source_cn: 试着克服恐惧，慢慢靠近那棵<style=highlig...
say:18:1510652017:1.male: Try to overcome your fear and slowly approach the <style="highlight">Wailing Oak</style>.
say:18:1510652017:1.female: Try to overcome your fear and slowly approach the <style="highlight">Wailing Oak</style>.

say:19:1510652018:1.text: As a Merlin, I know you can do it. I'll be right there with you.
say:19:1510652018:1.source_cn: 身为梅林的你，一定能做到。我会与你一起。
say:19:1510652018:1.male: As a Merlin, I know you can do it. I'll be right there with you.
say:19:1510652018:1.female: As a Merlin, I know you can do it. I'll be right there with you.

choice:14:0:1.text: I think I'm gonna pass out.
choice:14:0:1.male: I think I'm gonna pass out.
choice:14:0:1.female: I think I'm gonna pass out.

choice:14:1:2.text: How do we save anyone from this?
choice:14:1:2.male: How do we save anyone from this?
choice:14:1:2.female: How do we save anyone from this?

choice:5:0:1.text: I can't handle it, don't tell me.
choice:5:0:1.source_cn: 我承受能力差，别告诉我
choice:5:0:1.male: I can't handle it, don't tell me.
choice:5:0:1.female: I can't handle it, don't tell me.

say:21:1510652006:1.text: These are <style="highlight">human remains</style>... Human bodies, twisted and fused together.
say:21:1510652006:1.male: These are <style="highlight">human remains</style>... Human bodies, twisted and fused together.
say:21:1510652006:1.female: These are <style="highlight">human remains</style>... Human bodies, twisted and fused together.

say:22:1510652007:1.text: And what's worse, they're still alive. In a way... living on in this inhuman form.
say:22:1510652007:1.source_cn: 而且，他们还活着。以这种非人的姿态，在某种意义上活着……
say:22:1510652007:1.male: And what's worse, they're still alive. In a way... living on in this inhuman form.
say:22:1510652007:1.female: And what's worse, they're still alive. In a way... living on in this inhuman form.

choice:5:1:2.text: I can handle anything. Tell me.
choice:5:1:2.source_cn: 我什么都能接受，告诉我
choice:5:1:2.male: I can handle anything. Tell me.
choice:5:1:2.female: I can handle anything. Tell me.
